# VERDICT V2: Sea Time static page, Yotam's 5 edits

Backups of v1: `index-v1.html`, `css-v1/`, `js-v1/`. Scratch downloads (YouTube originals, page HTML, review JSON) were moved out of the served folder to `../sea-time-static-v2-sources/`.

1. **Mobile hero: done.** The video now fills the whole screen (100svh, object-fit cover). The header sits over it and stays transparent until the page scrolls 24px, then turns solid navy; this applies at every size. The kicker, headline, subline and both CTAs are overlaid in the lower part of the screen over a dark scrim. A long bottom gradient (0% → navy over the lower ~70%) dissolves the video into navy, and the "why" band below is now navy as well, so there is no hard edge. One rAF-throttled scroll handler fades the video to 30% opacity as the hero leaves the viewport; it is off under prefers-reduced-motion (the video stays paused). Desktop got the same navy blend at the bottom plus a slightly stronger top scrim for the now-transparent header. The pause button moved to the top on phones. Measured subline contrast against the actual pixels behind it: worst pixel 9.3:1 at 390×844, 7.9:1 at 360×640, 13.9:1 at 1440×900 (target ≥4.5).
2. **Course order: done on mobile and desktop.** The order is now משיט 30 → יוון → 7 מטר. On desktop, משיט 30 (the "הנמכר ביותר" card) takes the first, right-hand column in RTL, which strengthens the 3-column comparison rather than breaking it.
3. **Greece: done.** *Mobile:* their own photo "יוון-2" (harbour of a Greek island town, 2560×1440), taken from the image carousel on sea-time.co.il/skipper-course-in-greece/ (`wp-content/uploads/2025/04/יוון-2-scaled.webp`). It is cropped to 1080×1440, graded lightly (+contrast, +saturation), and shown above a translucent navy text panel, fading into navy at the bottom. *Desktop:* a background video from their own channel, YouTube **b7P1ugGUFHU** (@seatime2011, "קורס סקיפרים מתקדם ביוון - ים איגאי - ספטמבר 22"), cut at **1:34.4–1:44.9** (10.5s): the coloured boat-houses of Klima, then the white cliffs of Kleftiko with yachts at anchor. It is muted, looped, 1280×720 at 24fps, graded and lightly denoised, encoded as H.264 MP4 (2.9 MB) + VP9 WebM (2.5 MB), with a poster frame. It loads only on desktop, only when the section approaches the viewport, and never under reduced motion; phones never download it. I checked all 169 videos, 22 shorts and 0 streams on the channel. The only other Greece candidate, bdLcZOAqog8 (the promo embedded on their Greece page), has burnt-in captions and a watermark on nearly every shot. A second video embedded on that page (yo6P3yJ-oSE) belongs to another channel ("אוהד הנווד"), so I did not use it. No AI imagery anywhere; I skipped two ChatGPT-generated images that sit in their media library.
4. **Founders: done.** The person-at-the-wheel photo is replaced by their two real portraits from sea-time.co.il/our-story/ (`uploads/2025/06/בן-זגלשטיין.webp`, `uploads/2025/06/יונתן-ברסלר.webp`). Both are cropped to 4:5 at 720×900 with the faces at the same height, and the captions read exactly "בן זגלשטיין" and "יונתן ברסלר". The text is their "איך הכל התחיל" paragraph (founded 2010), quoted from the page, followed by a link to "הסיפור המלא". Their joint photo (בן-ויונתן.webp) also exists and could replace the pair if he prefers one image.
5. **Reviews: done.** These are six real Google reviews from the Trustindex widget on the sea-time.co.il home page; it is server-rendered, so a plain fetch read it and no browser was needed. They are in widget order: Raz Tirosh, MD, MHA · Pablo Arcuschin · Ohad Ranen · David Fleischer · Raphael Rosenbaum · שחר רגב. Text is verbatim with the original line breaks, typos and spacing. Each is a white card with the Google "G", five gold stars, the name, the text and "פורסם ב-Google", under the widget's own header: "מעולה", five stars, "מבוסס על 130 ביקורות". The widget shows **no dates** (its date field is empty), so the cards have none. Avatars are initial circles, not hotlinked Google profile photos. They swipe with scroll-snap below 900px and sit in a 3×2 grid on desktop.

**Verified** (Playwright + Chrome against the live URL, 390×844, 360×640, 1440×900): horizontal overflow 0 at all three sizes, no console errors or failed requests, all reveals fire. The header ends at y=64 and the hero copy starts at y=482 / 333 / 435, so they never overlap. The hero video plays, and the Greece video plays on desktop (WebM) and is not loaded on phones. Course order is confirmed in the DOM, and there are 6 review cards. With reduced motion there are no errors and the video stays paused. Screenshots: `screenshots/v2-{m390,s360,d1440}-{hero-top,hero-half,courses,greece,founders,reviews}.png` plus `v2-*-greece-panel.png` for phones. The raw report is in `screenshots/v2-report.json`, and the script is `tools/shoot-v2.mjs`.

**Not possible / open:** review dates (the live widget doesn't show them). I'm fairly confident the Greece video locations are Klima and Kleftiko on Milos, but the caption and alt text only say "ים האיגאי" / "אי יווני" until Sea Time confirms. The desktop Greece video is 720p, which looks slightly soft at 1440px+ under the scrim; their 1080p source would push the file past 4 MB.
